When a company makes a mistake today, foot- prints quickly show up on its back as competitionruns off with its business. To get the business back,the company has to wait for others to make mistakesand then figure out how to exploit the situation. So how do you avoid making mistakes in the first place? What are these marketing laws? And who brought them down from Mount Sinai on a set of stone tablets? The fundamental laws of marketing are those described in this book. But who says so? As far as we can tell, almost no one is willing to admit that there are any laws ofmarketing—certainly none that are immutable. There are laws of nature, so why shouldn’t there be laws of marketing?
